Requirement: User selects family + explicit target version
Finding: Create page has family/version UI, but target version is auto-derived from version count and frontend fixtures disagree with canonical corpus.
Required Action: Replace auto-next-version logic with explicit requested target version backed by backend repository intelligence.

Requirement: Project LLM reads repository/canonical I1+C1+D1 patterns
Finding: I1/C1/D1 reference pattern fixtures exist, but they are static TypeScript fixtures; no live repository-derived brief generation is connected to the FastAPI service.
Required Action: Move authoritative reference discovery/derivation to backend; frontend displays returned contract/evidence.

Requirement: Project LLM creates a self-contained implementation contract for an External AI with no project knowledge
Finding: External AI page contains a generic hard-coded prompt and brief; it does not contain the complete repository-derived contract needed for an outside agent to implement the project architecture.
Required Action: Generate a version-specific, self-contained implementation packet from backend evidence.

Requirement: Contract includes exact ILS implementation/participation requirements
Finding: Frontend says not to call ILS APIs, but backend certification/DAG wiring does not expose a canonical pre-implementation ILS contract; current checks are not sufficient to teach an external agent the exact project mechanism.
Required Action: Derive exact ILS contract from canonical runtime sources and expose it in the handoff package.

Requirement: Contract includes exact LSNB requirements
Finding: Frontend uses generic navigation language; backend final-gate comments defer ILS/LSNB/RSSB while no canonical pre-implementation contract is produced.
Required Action: Create repository-derived LSNB contract and post-upload verification.

Requirement: Contract includes exact RSSB requirements
Finding: Frontend labels RSSB as Rendering Structure & Style, while repository/backend terminology also uses RSSB as infrastructure; the contract is not authoritative or repository-derived.
Required Action: Resolve canonical RSSB definition from repository docs/code and use one authoritative contract.

Requirement: New candidate follows common I1/C1/D1 implementation architecture
Finding: Static reference patterns identify common artifacts, but backend Block Specification is mainly post-upload structural analysis and does not generate the full pre-implementation architecture contract.
Required Action: Create a real pre-candidate architecture synthesis service.

Requirement: Candidate upload is real and server-side
Finding: FastAPI candidate endpoint exists and computes comparison/manifest, but storage is in-memory and upload model is JSON CandidatePackage rather than a durable file/package intake.
Required Action: Add durable candidate artifact intake and server-side hash authority.

Requirement: Candidate is validated against intended family/version, not guessed
Finding: Candidate model has no explicit target family/version field; classification is heuristic and manifest writes blockVersion='1.0.0'.
Required Action: Bind candidate to workflow target family/version and reject mismatches.

Requirement: Canonical comparison is real in the canonical DAG
Finding: Real CanonicalComparator exists and is used by route/other agents, but 15-agent Agent 7 coordinator path explicitly returns a stub result.
Required Action: Wire Agent 7 directly to CanonicalComparator.

Requirement: Placement is evidence-backed and approval-gated
Finding: Manifest and executor exist, with hash checks and approval checks; governance is in-memory and the Agent 09 database polling implementation is still mock.
Required Action: Unify approval authority and persist approval/manifest state.

Requirement: Certification gates are real, not fabricated PASS
Finding: Real CertificationGateExecutor exists, but canonical 15-agent certification controller still sets every gate to PASS in a stub handler.
Required Action: Wire Agent 12 to real gate executor and propagate BLOCKED/FAIL.

Requirement: Runtime and browser verification are real in canonical DAG
Finding: Real runtime/browser modules exist, but Agent 13 and Agent 14 coordinator branches explicitly return stub statuses.
Required Action: Wire real runtime and Playwright agents into DAG.

Requirement: Final gate aggregates real gate evidence and blocks on uncertainty
Finding: FinalGateAgent is substantial, but canonical coordinator invokes a generic gate controller rather than the full FinalGateAgent; final-gate logic also has an empty-gates PASS fallback.
Required Action: Execute FinalGateAgent as Agent 15 and make missing gates BLOCKED.

Requirement: Canonical lifecycle is one authority
Finding: 15-agent DAG exists, but WorkflowEngine still defines a second generic CREATED→DISCOVERY→PLANNING→... lifecycle and frontend has another TS coordinator.
Required Action: Retire/reduce secondary workflow authorities; use canonical lifecycle only.

Requirement: Frontend is connected to FastAPI backend
Finding: Project LLM workflow pages inspected contain no fetch/axios calls; state is localStorage/static fixtures.
Required Action: Add typed API client and bind every workflow state/action to backend contracts.

Requirement: Candidate validation UI reports actual backend evidence
Finding: Candidate Upload page hard-codes passed checks and simulated progress; it is not driven by candidate API/gate results.
Required Action: Render backend validation/evidence results; missing evidence must be BLOCKED.

Requirement: Integration/certification UI reflects actual certification
Finding: Integration page contains hard-coded certification/runtime/composer success claims and 'Candidate Certified & Integrated' UI.
Required Action: Make certification UI backend-driven and prohibit success claims without evidence.

Requirement: Composer visibility is actually verified
Finding: Backend has Composer verification code, but canonical DAG certification wiring is stubbed; frontend links to Composer and displays success without real verification.
Required Action: Require registry→renderer→Composer→construct→TutorialDocument→runtime evidence before enabling Composer.

Requirement: Brand/theme architecture is enforced like I1/C1/D1
Finding: Real theme/brand verification modules exist; static brief says brand-independent, but current External AI contract is generic and canonical coordinator does not execute the real certification gate path.
Required Action: Generate exact theme/brand contract from repository and wire real gates.

Requirement: Canonical artifact policy: update existing docs/files instead of duplicating
Finding: Project material documents the rule, and final-gate code appends to a canonical backlog, but no end-to-end enforcement was found in the candidate integration contract.
Required Action: Make canonical-artifact search/update decision an explicit gate with evidence.

Requirement: No legacy Mix & Match creation authority
Finding: CreationMode still includes MIX_AND_MATCH and creation route still implements a separate composition workflow.
Required Action: Remove/reclassify legacy creation workflow; keep Mix & Match only as design/reuse input if needed.

Requirement: Durable production persistence
Finding: Governance/candidate/workflow state is in-memory in current M2 implementation; README explicitly marks persistence as future.
Required Action: Implement persistence after canonical workflow wiring, before production certification.

Requirement: FastAPI is the backend authority; GUI is a control/view surface
Finding: Architecture intent is correct, but frontend still owns workflow state/fixtures and a TS coordinator; backend is not yet authoritative for the GUI workflow.
Required Action: Make backend contracts authoritative and frontend thin.
